Public, canonical, nav-linked showcase — it satisfies the same membership rule the sitemap generator applies, so it is a sitemap target.

Public verified external-link inventory (Issue #390); renders the committed src/about/links.ts inventory and is linked from /about, but is not a sitemap target.
Public portfolio index; lists published projects only.

Public project introduction; renders the committed public-README snapshot and states its own freshness. Deliberately not a nav destination, so it is not advertised through the sitemap inventory.
Public tool index. `host_disabled` entries render as "Coming soon" and are deliberately not linkable.
Per-tool iframe shell. Expands from the tool manifest rows with an embeddable delivery kind, but the shell declares `robots: noindex` in its own head, so it is not a sitemap target.
